data.title: Two homes on the list
data.situation: After another crowded rush hour, Lin reached home late and opened a rental website. The train fare was rising, and her daily commute left little time for dinner. She drew a circle around her workplace on a map, then set three filters: a flat or studio, a journey of no more than thirty minutes, and an advertised price within her monthly budget. A studio near work appeared first. It was small, but its location made it worth considering. A cheaper flat in the suburb would leave her with the same long train journey, so she removed that listing. She saved the studio and a second flat near a station to a shortlist. Neither was perfect, and she still needed to check the full costs. Her next step was to ask about both listings.
data.goal: Describe housing needs, set filters for location, home type and budget, and make a shortlist for later enquiries.
data.zhSupport: 林的早高峰通勤又长又贵。她在租房平台按地点、房型、路程与预算筛选，排除仍要久坐火车的城郊房源，留下两处待询问的住处。她尚未看房，也没有确认全部费用。先用英文说出筛选理由，再看示例。

glossary.note: 指上下班人流与车流集中的时段；这里是林拥挤通勤的背景。
commute 在这里是名词，指住处与工作地点之间经常往返的路程。
在找房平台上按房型、路程和价格缩小结果范围；three 可按实际条件替换。
within budget 表示不超过可支配的预算；广告价格只是初筛依据，实际总费用还要核对。
这里是火车票价，不是房租。
英式英语中指公寓住房；这里与单间公寓 studio 比较。
通常以一个主要房间兼作起居与睡眠空间；不能只凭户型推断是否合适。
城市中心外围的居住区；这里便宜的房源仍会让林花很长时间坐火车。
名词；在本场景中指林为每月住房支出设定的上限。
从较多选项中选出少数值得进一步了解的对象；在这里还没有决定租哪一套。
表达正在寻找的住处或事物；后接所找对象。 本项目构式/表达组合，不冒充原资料固定搭配。
替换人称后保留预算上限的意思。 本项目构式/表达组合，不冒充原资料固定搭配。

retrievalPrompts.function: Explain why a new home is needed
retrievalPrompts.cue: Lin's train is crowded, and the journey leaves little time at home. Explain why she starts looking for another place.
acceptableAnswers: Her commute during rush hour takes too long, so she wants to live closer to work.
She is looking for a new home because the crowded journey to work takes too much time.
Her daily commute during rush hour takes too long, so she wants to live closer to work.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Rush hour names the busy travel period; commute names the regular journey. Give a cause and the housing need it creates.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 林每天往返工作地点很花时间，高峰时段又挤。解释她为什么开始找新住处。
checks: 是否解释了来回路程造成的困难？
是否说明了希望住得离工作地点更近？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 说明通勤困难和找房目的；说法不同也可以完成意图。

retrievalPrompts.cue: A cheap place outside the city would still mean a long train ride. State a useful location or journey limit.
acceptableAnswers: I want a place within thirty minutes of work so my commute is shorter.
Please show me homes near work; the suburb would leave me with a long journey.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: A location filter is useful when it changes the journey. State a concrete time or area, and explain why the distant option is removed.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 便宜的城郊住处仍要坐很久的火车。说出一个有用的找房地点或路程限制。
checks: 是否给出具体地点或时间限制？
限制是否能缩短往返路程？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 先给出可执行条件，再说明它怎样解决路程问题。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Lin is open to two kinds of homes. One has several rooms; the other has one main living and sleeping space. State her search preference.
acceptableAnswers: I am looking for a flat or a studio near work.
Please include both flats and studios in my search.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Flat is a general apartment term in British English. A studio has one main living and sleeping room. Either can remain an option at this stage.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 林愿意考虑整套公寓，也愿意考虑起居和睡眠共用一个主房间的住处。向中介说明她接受的两种房型。
checks: 是否表达寻找住处的需求？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 两种房型不同，但都能作为候选。

retrievalPrompts.function: Set a price limit and build a shortlist
retrievalPrompts.cue: Two advertised prices fit Lin's limit. She wants to save those homes and ask about the full cost later. Describe that step.
acceptableAnswers: I set a monthly budget and saved two listings to my shortlist.
Both homes fit my price limit, so I will shortlist them and check the total cost later.
Both homes are within my monthly budget, so I saved them to a shortlist. I still need to check the full cost.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: A shortlist is a small set of options for the next enquiry. The advertised price is an initial filter; it does not establish the full cost.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 两处房源的广告价格都在林的每月支出上限内。说出她如何留下少数候选，准备下一步询问全部费用。
checks: 是否说清预算限制和保留候选的步骤？
是否把广告价格和全部费用区分开？
retrievalPrompts.feedbackZh: 预算限制用于初筛，广告价不能替代全部支出。

transferPrompt.function: Transfer housing filters to a new campus journey
transferPrompt.cue: A friend has a long journey to a new campus. Their limit is 900 a month, and they want a one-room apartment within twenty minutes of campus. Without reopening Lin's story, describe the filters and the next selection step.
acceptableAnswers: I would search for a studio within twenty minutes of campus and under 900 a month, then shortlist two suitable places.
My budget is 900 a month, so I would filter for studios near campus and save a few options with a shorter commute.
transferPrompt.feedback: Change the destination and figures while keeping the useful actions: set a home type, journey limit and budget, then save a few options for enquiries.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 一位朋友要去新校园上学：希望找一个主房间兼作起居和睡眠的住处，路程不超过二十分钟，每月上限九百。说明筛选条件，并说出如何留下少数候选供下一步询问。
checks: 是否说明了路程、房型、预算和保留候选的步骤？
是否按学生的新条件表达，而非照背林的故事？
transferPrompt.feedbackZh: 换人物之后保留筛选逻辑；不要求把所有候选表达塞进同一句。

data.easySummary: Lin wants a home near work. She looks at two homes. She checks the journey, home type and price. She has not chosen a home yet.
data.easySummaryZh: 林想住得离工作地点近些。她比较两个住处，检查路程、房型和价格，还没有做决定。
